_comment: Chart-license gate policy (DATA, not code). ADR-0706 D-5 / bead oyatie-f2fg. The Cargo license gate (cloud-ci-license-policy) covers Cargo.toml only, so it never sees the Helm charts infra/gitops/values.yaml's `apps[]` (type: chart entries) and observability/iac/helm/*/Chart.yaml's `dependencies[]` pull from third-party Helm repositories. Every chart pull this gate finds must be a DECLARED entry below, keyed by (repository, chart) since chart names collide across repos (e.g. `postgresql` at charts.bitnami.com is unrelated to any other `postgresql`). An undeclared pull fails closed (gitops_chart_license_undeclared_chart) rather than silently passing -- adding a new chart is a reviewed, one-line policy edit, not a silent gap. Licenses were verified against each project's own LICENSE file as of 2026-08-19 (see bead oyatie-f2fg evidence) and ADR-0706 D-5's licence table (the source of truth for the observability entries specifically, including the Tempo correction).

ops-internal._doc: Internal SRE/ops tooling: no distribution, no network provision to a third party (AGPL S13 does not engage). ADR-0706 D-5 extends the ADR-0705 dev-only carve-out to ops-internal use.

tenant-facing._doc: ADR-0705 Tier-1 permissive only. No AGPL component may be embedded in, proxied by, or queried by a tenant-facing route -- the data plane follows the product, not the console (ADR-0706 D-5 point 3).

sources._doc: Where this gate looks for chart pulls. Both are read structurally (parsed YAML), not grepped.
sources.gitops_values_doc: Every `apps[]` entry with `type: chart` names a direct third-party Helm pull via `repoURL` + `chart`. `type: path` entries reference in-repo directories (e.g. the `observability` app itself, `openbao`) and are out of this gate's scope -- their content, if a Helm chart, is scanned via observability_chart_dirs below.
sources.observability_chart_dirs_doc: Each first-party umbrella chart's own `dependencies[]` array names the real upstream Helm chart it wraps (name + repository), the same structural signal Helm itself uses to resolve subcharts. A chart with no `dependencies` block (axe-pa11y-runner, timescaledb-extension) pulls nothing external and emits no row.

entries.note: cluster CNI; GPL-2.0 applies only to the in-kernel eBPF programs it loads at runtime, not to the chart or control-plane binaries this pull distributes
statuspage readside store; PostgreSQL licence is a permissive MIT/BSD-family variant
the one Apache-2.0 chart in the Grafana Labs family (fleet-wide collector); do not conflate with the AGPL entries below (ADR-0706 D-5's own historical misclassification)
upstream repository is archived; tracked separately, not a licence concern

_min_expected_rows_doc: Anti-vacuity floor (shrink-only): if a broken parse or an emptied source ever made the scan see fewer chart pulls than this, every plane assertion below would be vacuously green. Set to the corpus measured 2026-08-20: 11 distinct infra/gitops type:chart (repository, chart) pairs + 13 distinct observability/iac/helm dependency pairs = 24.
